_comment: Copy to ~/.cursor/permissions.json or <project>/.cursor/permissions.json. Match the MCP server name in mcp.json (often "proxmox"). Requires Cursor Run Mode Auto-review or Allowlist. See https://cursor.com/docs/reference/permissions

allow_instructions: Allow Proxmox MCP inventory, wait_for_task, provision/deploy/push/exec day-2 tools without prompting when they match the mcpAllowlist.
block_instructions: Always pause before reboot_node, shutdown_node, join_cluster, create_ceph_osd, destroy_ceph_osd, delete_ceph_pool, delete_vm, delete_lxc, delete_guest, and any tool that permanently deletes cluster resources.
Never auto-approve broad proxmox:* wildcards for destructive host or Ceph operations.
